name: Sphere Corp.
summary: Sphere Corp. provides digital healthcare technology, and life care products and services. It develops LifeRecord, a commercial personal health record platform that manages health-related data, including medical records, genome data, and personally generated health data. The company also offers digital healthcare services for consumers, such as non-face-to-face treatment, medication management, and health management, as well as patient communities with digital health enablement comprising digital therapeutics and software-based medical devices using artificial intelligence technology.
